accepted_conditions: no credentials, secrets, tokens, or private keys
no pricing, outreach, contracting, delivery, publication, or external execution authority

rejection_conditions.condition: Source is private, access-controlled, or requires credentials.
Input contains or appears to contain credentials, tokens, private keys, or authentication material.
Input contains customer content, direct identifiers, sensitive personal data, or prohibited PII.
Instruction could authorize pricing, outreach, contracting, delivery, publication, repository writes, or external execution.
Objective has no fixed source, claim boundary, stop condition, or human gate.
Normalized instruction and interpreted scope cannot be confirmed without guessing.

required_inputs.rule: Repository must be publicly accessible and approved for read-only internal analysis.
An exact branch, commit, or immutable source snapshot must be recorded.
The objective must describe what evidence-backed value is being evaluated.
Intent-preserving normalized wording must be reviewed before consequential action.
One-way binding only; verbatim raw text is not required.
Only explicitly allowed factual claim classes may become effective records.
Unsupported, runtime, commercial, or sensitive topics must remain withheld.
